purpose: Complete approved appearance; extraction, not image generation, is reproducible

prompts.locomotion: Create a NEW transparent PIXEL-ART ANIMATION SOURCE SHEET using the attached Basalt character as the locked appearance reference. Preserve his recognisable human face, brown skin, charcoal hair with white streak, bright yellow headband and sash, crimson-red outfit and red/yellow armour, dark stone-linked whip with yellow joints, and exact body proportions. ONE consistent character, complete connected whole-body drawings, identical body scale and lighting. No separate torso/leg parts. Simple hard-edged game sprites: flat 2-tone colours, strong black outline, tiny 44-pixel logical body height, not glossy or painterly. Twelve isolated cells in a precise SIX-column TWO-row grid on a fully TRANSPARENT background. Every cell same size and foot baseline, ample blank gutters. No text, borders, shadows on a background, rock props or scenery. Row one: four successive quiet idle breathing poses with BOTH FEET planted at exactly the same places and the whip coiled at his side, a brief hit-recoil pose, then return-to-guard stance. Row two: SIX DIFFERENT consecutive WALK CYCLE drawings facing right, clearly alternating the legs: left heel strikes forward/right leg behind; left foot plants/right heel lifts; right leg passes underneath; right heel strikes forward/left leg behind; right foot plants/left heel lifts; left leg passes underneath. Keep the waist at the same baseline, calm heavy walking rather than sprinting, with natural opposing arm and headband movement and the coiled whip held low. Do not duplicate the same leg arrangement six times. Preserve armour and colours across all twelve drawings. Native sprites will be extracted and reduced to about 44 pixels tall, so broad red/yellow colour blocks and opaque silhouettes are essential.
